items.name: NumberField.Ideal.tendsto_norm_le_div_atTop

items.name: ProbabilityTheory.tendsto_charFun_inv_sqrt_mul_pow
items.type: {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : AEMeasurable X P) (h0 : ∫ (x : Ω), X x ∂P = 0) (h1 : ∫ (x : Ω), (X ^ 2) x ∂P = 1) (t : ℝ) : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => MeasureTheory.charFun (MeasureTheory.Measure.map X P) ((√↑n)⁻¹ * t) ^ n) Filter.atTop (nhds (Complex.exp (-↑t ^ 2 / 2)))
